title: Productive Aging in Developing Countries
discussion_signal: The post discusses older people’s access to market and non-market work and the limits of working in old age. It frames ageing as a question of wellbeing, productivity, household roles, and policy design rather than simply a dependency burden.
linked_research_question: How do work, care, health, and policy conditions shape older people’s agency and wellbeing in developing economies?
limits: Individual summary of a World Bank report
No country-level lived experience is presented
The post does not establish which policies improve outcomes
